def real_axis_analysis(poly, coordinate, router):
    """Keep the complex polynomial and isolate its exact real common roots."""
    normalized = router.call('analysis-2', 'sp.Poly', None, (router.call('analysis-1', 'method.as_expr', router.call('analysis-0', 'method.monic', poly, (), {}), (), {}), coordinate), {'domain': sp.QQ_I})
    router.observe('analysis-observation0', 'normalized', normalized)
    expression = router.call('analysis-3', 'method.as_expr', normalized, (), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation1', 'expression', expression)
    real = router.call('analysis-6', 'sp.Poly', None, (router.call('analysis-5', 'method.expand', router.call('analysis-4', 'sp.re', None, (expression,), {}), (), {}), coordinate), {'domain': sp.QQ})
    router.observe('analysis-observation2', 'real', real)
    imag = router.call('analysis-9', 'sp.Poly', None, (router.call('analysis-8', 'method.expand', router.call('analysis-7', 'sp.im', None, (expression,), {}), (), {}), coordinate), {'domain': sp.QQ})
    router.observe('analysis-observation3', 'imag', imag)
    decomposition = router.call('analysis-15', 'sp.expand', None, (router.arithmetic('analysis-14', 'Sub', router.arithmetic('analysis-11', 'Sub', expression, router.call('analysis-10', 'method.as_expr', real, (), {})), router.arithmetic('analysis-13', 'Mult', sp.I, router.call('analysis-12', 'method.as_expr', imag, (), {}))),), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation4', 'decomposition', decomposition)
    common = router.call('analysis-16', 'sp.gcd', None, (real, imag), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation5', 'common', common)
    squarefree = router.call('analysis-17', 'method.sqf_part', common, (), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation6', 'squarefree', squarefree)
    (real_quotient, real_remainder) = router.call('analysis-18', 'sp.div', None, (real, common), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation7', 'real_quotient', real_quotient)
    router.observe('analysis-observation8', 'real_remainder', real_remainder)
    (imag_quotient, imag_remainder) = router.call('analysis-19', 'sp.div', None, (imag, common), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation9', 'imag_quotient', imag_quotient)
    router.observe('analysis-observation10', 'imag_remainder', imag_remainder)
    if imag.is_zero:
        bezout_real = router.call('analysis-22', 'sp.Poly', None, (router.arithmetic('analysis-21', 'Div', 1, router.call('analysis-20', 'method.LC', real, (), {})), coordinate), {'domain': sp.QQ})
        router.observe('analysis-observation11', 'bezout_real', bezout_real)
        bezout_imag = router.call('analysis-23', 'sp.Poly', None, (0, coordinate), {'domain': sp.QQ})
        router.observe('analysis-observation12', 'bezout_imag', bezout_imag)
        gcd = router.call('analysis-24', 'method.monic', real, (), {})
        router.observe('analysis-observation13', 'gcd', gcd)
    else:
        (bezout_real, bezout_imag, gcd) = router.call('analysis-25', 'sp.gcdex', None, (real, imag), {})
        router.observe('analysis-observation14', 'bezout_real', bezout_real)
        router.observe('analysis-observation15', 'bezout_imag', bezout_imag)
        router.observe('analysis-observation16', 'gcd', gcd)
    bezout_residual = router.call('analysis-35', 'sp.expand', None, (router.arithmetic('analysis-34', 'Sub', router.arithmetic('analysis-32', 'Add', router.arithmetic('analysis-28', 'Mult', router.call('analysis-26', 'method.as_expr', bezout_real, (), {}), router.call('analysis-27', 'method.as_expr', real, (), {})), router.arithmetic('analysis-31', 'Mult', router.call('analysis-29', 'method.as_expr', bezout_imag, (), {}), router.call('analysis-30', 'method.as_expr', imag, (), {}))), router.call('analysis-33', 'method.as_expr', common, (), {})),), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation17', 'bezout_residual', bezout_residual)
    intervals = router.call('analysis-38', 'method.intervals', squarefree, (), {'eps': router.call('analysis-37', 'sp.Rational', None, (1, router.arithmetic('analysis-36', 'Pow', 10, 12)), {})})
    router.observe('analysis-observation18', 'intervals', intervals)
    factorization = router.call('analysis-39', 'sp.factor_list', None, (expression, coordinate), {'extension': sp.I})
    router.observe('analysis-observation19', 'factorization', factorization)
    reconstruction = router.call('analysis-44', 'sp.expand', None, (router.arithmetic('analysis-43', 'Sub', router.arithmetic('analysis-42', 'Mult', factorization[0], router.call('analysis-41', 'sp.prod', None, ((router.arithmetic('analysis-40', 'Pow', v, n) for (v, n) in factorization[1]),), {})), expression),), {})
    router.observe('analysis-observation20', 'reconstruction', reconstruction)
    result = {'normalized': normalized, 'complexSquarefree': router.call('analysis-45', 'method.sqf_part', normalized, (), {}), 'realPart': router.call('analysis-46', 'method.as_expr', real, (), {}), 'imaginaryPart': router.call('analysis-47', 'method.as_expr', imag, (), {}), 'decompositionResidual': decomposition, 'realCommonFactor': router.call('analysis-48', 'method.as_expr', common, (), {}), 'realSquarefree': router.call('analysis-49', 'method.as_expr', squarefree, (), {}), 'realQuotient': router.call('analysis-50', 'method.as_expr', real_quotient, (), {}), 'imaginaryQuotient': router.call('analysis-51', 'method.as_expr', imag_quotient, (), {}), 'divisionResiduals': (router.call('analysis-52', 'method.as_expr', real_remainder, (), {}), router.call('analysis-53', 'method.as_expr', imag_remainder, (), {})), 'bezoutReal': router.call('analysis-54', 'method.as_expr', bezout_real, (), {}), 'bezoutImaginary': router.call('analysis-55', 'method.as_expr', bezout_imag, (), {}), 'bezoutResidual': bezout_residual, 'intervals': intervals, 'factorization': factorization, 'factorReconstructionResidual': reconstruction, 'scope': 'For real frequency coefficients, both actual real and imaginary polynomial parts must vanish. The complex polynomial, denominator and sheet artifacts are retained.'}
    router.observe('analysis-observation21', 'result', result)
    f.require(decomposition == reconstruction == bezout_residual == 0 and real_remainder.is_zero and imag_remainder.is_zero and (gcd == common), 'exact real-axis polynomial decomposition/divisibility/Bezout joins')
    router.guard('analysis-guard22')
    f.require(sum((n for (_, n) in intervals)) == router.call('analysis-56', 'method.count_roots', squarefree, (-sp.oo, sp.oo), {}), 'complete real isolation for computed common polynomial')
    router.guard('analysis-guard23')
    for ((left, right), multiplicity) in intervals:
        f.require(multiplicity == 1 and router.call('analysis-57', 'method.count_roots', squarefree, (left, right), {}) == 1, 'individual real common-root interval')
        router.guard('analysis-guard24')
    return result
